subject.title: refactor(agents): move implicit-main fallback into load-time roster injection

question: After the contributor supplies real runtime proof, should maintainers accept this broad roster-ownership migration as the canonical compatibility boundary for existing installations?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes where configuration, sessions, auth paths, and channel state derive their default agent; CI and unit tests cannot by themselves settle the upgrade contract or ownership acceptance for this protected maintainer item.

options.title: Require runtime upgrade proof, then review

options.title: Pause for a narrower rollout
